title: Add creator credit banner to top of Home page

requirements.text: Add a full-width banner at the very top of the Home page (route "/") that displays the creator credits exactly as provided, above the existing hero section content in HomePage.tsx.

quotes:
Add
Created by:
Albin B Tom and Nikita Maria Bino
6 BBA SBA B
of Christ University, Yeshwanthpur
At the top of the website in the home tab
full‑width banner at the very top

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, a visually distinct full-width banner appears before the hero section.
The banner text matches exactly (including line breaks/line separation): "Created by:", "Albin B Tom and Nikita Maria Bino", "6 BBA SBA B", "of Christ University, Yeshwanthpur".
The banner is responsive: on mobile and desktop it remains readable, does not overflow horizontally, and spans edge-to-edge across the viewport.
No creator banner appears on non-Home routes (e.g., /about, /models).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components are read-only).
Do not change backend state or add new backend APIs for this UI-only change.
nonGoals: Adding the creator credit banner site-wide on every page.
Changing existing Home page hero text, CTA buttons, or navigation behavior.
